# xterm.js (vendored)

The web client's terminal buffers (`xi.web.terminal`) load these on first use.
Unmodified builds from npm, minus their source-map comments:

- `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0 — `lib/xterm.js`, `css/xterm.css`
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0 — `lib/addon-fit.js`

Both MIT: `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-addon-fit`. To update, replace the files from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@xterm/xterm@<v>/…` and bump the versions here.
